subject_note: In every requirement, 'the system' is the system of interest, the block SmartIntersectionCore.

ConfigureScenario.goal: Set up a scenario (traffic demand, road users, signal timing) that the system accepts as valid.

RunIntersection.goal: Start, pause and reset a run in which the system moves road users and switches signals safely.

InspectTelemetry.goal: Understand what the simulation is doing and why, from live state, events and metrics.

ExecuteTestRun.goal: Run a scenario repeatably and obtain traces and results for verification.

SubmitPerceptionDetections.goal: Deliver detections to the smart vehicle and get them acknowledged (planned extension).

containers.name: SIS_Requirements
containers.text: The system shall fulfil the contained functional, non-functional and operational-design-domain requirements.

containers.name: FUN_Functional
containers.title: Functional requirements
containers.text: The system shall provide the contained functions.

containers.name: NFR_NonFunctional
containers.title: Non-functional requirements
containers.text: The system shall meet the contained quality requirements.

containers.name: ODD_OperationalDesignDomain
containers.title: Operational design domain
containers.text: The system shall operate within the operational design domain defined in Milestone 1.

containers.name: SIG_SignalControl
containers.title: Traffic signal control
containers.text: The system shall control the traffic signals of the intersection.

containers.name: RUN_ScenarioAndRunControl
containers.title: Scenario and run control
containers.text: The system shall let the operator configure scenarios and control runs.

containers.name: AGT_RoadUserBehaviour
containers.title: Road-user behaviour
containers.text: The system shall simulate the behaviour of vehicle and pedestrian agents.

containers.name: SV_SmartVehicle
containers.title: Smart-vehicle perception and decision
containers.text: The system shall model the perception-based decisions of the smart vehicle.

containers.name: OBS_TelemetryAndEvaluation
containers.title: Telemetry and evaluation
containers.text: The system shall make the state and the results of every run observable.

requirements.name: SIG_01_PhaseSequence
requirements.text: The system shall switch the vehicle signals in the repeating sequence N/S green, N/S amber, all-red, E/W green, E/W amber, all-red.
requirements.rationale: Two mutually exclusive movement groups with amber and all-red clearance is the signal plan of the ODD; all other signal requirements assume this order.

requirements.name: SIG_02_NoConflictingGreens
requirements.text: While a vehicle movement group shows green or amber, the system shall show red to the other vehicle movement group.
requirements.rationale: Primary safety invariant: conflicting vehicle movements never have permission at the same time.
requirements.source: Road authority; occupants; drivers; check T1

requirements.name: SIG_03_ProtectedCrossing
requirements.text: While a pedestrian crossing shows walk or pedestrian clearance, the system shall show red to every vehicle movement group that crosses it.
requirements.rationale: Protected pedestrian permission: a pedestrian on the crossing is never in conflict with a permitted vehicle movement.
requirements.source: Pedestrians; road authority; check T1; conflict C1

requirements.name: SIG_04_ServeCrossingRequest
requirements.text: When a pedestrian agent requests to cross, the system shall show walk on that crossing in the next phase in which every vehicle movement group that crosses it shows red.
requirements.rationale: Bounds the pedestrian waiting time to at most one signal cycle while respecting SIG-03.

requirements.name: SIG_05_PedestrianClearance
requirements.text: The system shall give every pedestrian clearance interval a duration of at least the crossing length divided by 0.8 m/s.
requirements.rationale: The slowest pedestrian in the ODD (0.8 m/s) can finish crossing before a conflicting vehicle movement receives green.

requirements.name: RUN_01_LoadScenario
requirements.text: When the system receives a load-scenario command, the system shall initialise the road geometry, agents, arrival times, timing plan and random seed from that scenario.
requirements.rationale: All inputs that determine a run come from one scenario, which makes runs repeatable and comparable.

requirements.name: RUN_02_RejectInvalidTiming
requirements.text: If a requested signal duration is outside its permitted range (green 5-60 s, amber 2-5 s, all-red 1-3 s, walk 5-30 s), then the system shall reject the request and report the permitted range.
requirements.rationale: An out-of-range duration could create an unsafe or unrealistic plan; reporting the range lets the operator correct the request.
requirements.source: Road authority; operator; check T3; conflict C3

requirements.name: RUN_03_ApplyPlanAtAllRed
requirements.text: While an accepted timing plan is pending, the system shall keep the active timing plan until the next all-red interval starts.
requirements.rationale: A timing change can then never shorten an active green, amber or pedestrian clearance interval.
requirements.source: Road authority; pedestrians; check T3; conflict C3

requirements.name: RUN_04_AcknowledgeCommand
requirements.text: When the system receives an operator command, the system shall acknowledge the command as accepted, or as rejected with a reason, within one simulation step.
requirements.rationale: The dashboard only requests changes and the model decides; an explicit acknowledgement shows the operator which value is active.

requirements.name: RUN_05_Reset
requirements.text: When the system receives a reset command, the system shall restore the initial state of the loaded scenario.
requirements.rationale: The operator can repeat a run without reloading, e.g. to compare two timing plans on the same traffic.

requirements.name: RUN_06_Pause
requirements.text: While a run is paused, the system shall keep the simulation time and the state of every signal and agent unchanged.
requirements.rationale: Pausing freezes the whole model, so the operator can inspect a situation without the state moving on.

requirements.name: RUN_07_SingleStep
requirements.text: While a run is paused, when the system receives a step command, the system shall advance the simulation by exactly one simulation step.
requirements.rationale: Step-wise execution lets the team inspect each state-machine transition during debugging and the demonstration.

requirements.name: AGT_01_UpdateAgents
requirements.text: The system shall update the position and speed of every agent once per simulation step.
requirements.rationale: Agent motion is owned by the model, not by the dashboard, and is consistent with the fixed time step (NFR-02).

requirements.name: AGT_02_StopOnRed
requirements.text: While an approach shows red, the system shall keep every vehicle agent on that approach that has not passed the stop line behind the stop line.
requirements.rationale: Red-light compliance of every vehicle, smart and conventional.
requirements.source: Occupants; drivers; road authority; check T2; conflict C1

requirements.name: AGT_03_StopOnAmber
requirements.text: When an approach changes to amber, the system shall stop every vehicle agent on that approach that can stop before the stop line with a deceleration of at most 4.5 m/s^2.
requirements.rationale: Vehicles that can stop comfortably do so and vehicles too close to stop proceed; with amber of at least 2 s and speed of at most 8.5 m/s this makes AGT-02 achievable.
requirements.source: Occupants (braking within limits); drivers; conflict C1

requirements.name: AGT_04_PedestrianStartsOnWalk
requirements.text: The system shall start a pedestrian agent across a crossing only while that crossing shows walk.
requirements.rationale: Pedestrians in the ODD comply with the signals, so their safety follows from SIG-03.

requirements.name: SV_01_DecideOnObservation
requirements.text: The system shall base every stop, yield or proceed decision of the smart vehicle on the smart vehicle's observed state of signals, vehicles and pedestrians.
requirements.rationale: Makes the perception-to-decision chain explicit and testable, as for a real automated vehicle.

requirements.name: SV_02_SeparateGroundTruth
requirements.text: The system shall store the smart vehicle's observed state separately from the simulated ground truth.
requirements.rationale: A perception error can then be detected by comparing observation with ground truth instead of being hidden.
requirements.source: Smart-vehicle developers; course team; conflict C4

requirements.name: SV_03_UncertainSignalIsRed
requirements.text: If the smart vehicle's latest observation of its signal is missing, older than 0.5 s or has a confidence below 0.8, then the system shall treat that signal as red for the smart vehicle.
requirements.rationale: Fail-safe interpretation of uncertain perception: an unconfirmed green is never acted upon. Thresholds are proposed values.
requirements.source: Occupants; pedestrians; check T5; conflict C4

requirements.name: SV_04_AcceptDetections
requirements.text: Where the ML perception service is connected, the system shall accept time-stamped detection events containing object class, signal indication and confidence through the perception interface.
requirements.rationale: Enables the planned ML extension without making it a dependency of the baseline.

requirements.name: OBS_01_StateSnapshot
requirements.text: The system shall publish a state snapshot every simulation step containing the simulation time, the active phase, every signal indication, and the id, type, position, speed and state of every agent.
requirements.rationale: The dashboard displays only model-owned state; a complete snapshot every step means a lost message is replaced by the next one.

requirements.name: OBS_02_EventLog
requirements.text: When a phase change, operator command, vehicle stop at a stop line, crossing request, crossing completion or safety-rule violation occurs, the system shall record a time-stamped event in the run log.
requirements.rationale: The event log is the evidence for verification (checks T1-T4) and the basis for comparing runs.

requirements.name: OBS_03_RunMetrics
requirements.text: When a run ends, the system shall report the waiting time of every agent, the maximum queue length per arm and the number of vehicle stops.
requirements.rationale: Quantifies the delay-versus-safety trade-off between timing plans.
requirements.source: Operator / researcher; road authority; drivers; check T4; conflicts C1, C2

requirements.name: NFR_01_Reproducibility
requirements.text: The system shall produce identical event logs for any two runs of the same scenario with the same random seed and timing plan.
requirements.rationale: A difference between two runs can then be attributed to the changed parameter only.
requirements.source: Operator; course team; check T4; conflict C3

requirements.name: NFR_02_FixedTimeStep
requirements.text: The system shall advance the simulation time in fixed steps of 0.1 s.
requirements.rationale: A fixed step makes behaviour deterministic and gives 10 snapshots per simulated second for the dashboard.

requirements.name: NFR_03_ModelIsAuthority
requirements.text: The system shall take every signal, movement and right-of-way decision inside the executable Rhapsody model.
requirements.rationale: Rhapsody is the single source of truth; external tools may only request changes, which keeps behaviour traceable to the SysML model.

requirements.name: NFR_04_RejectMalformedMessage
requirements.text: If the system receives a message that does not conform to the interface schema, then the system shall discard the message, log a diagnostic event and continue the run.
requirements.rationale: Faulty input from the dashboard, the test harness or the ML service must not stop or corrupt the simulation.

requirements.name: NFR_05_SurviveDashboardLoss
requirements.text: If the connection to the dashboard is lost during a run, then the system shall continue the run without loss of simulation state.
requirements.rationale: The dashboard is only a viewer; closing or restarting it must not affect the run.

requirements.name: NFR_06_AnimatedStates
requirements.text: While animation is enabled, the system shall display the active state of every signal and agent state machine in Rhapsody animation.
requirements.rationale: Makes the executable behaviour inspectable for debugging and for the live demonstration.

requirements.name: NFR_07_ReplaceablePerception
requirements.text: The system shall allow the perception source of the smart vehicle to be switched between idealized and ML-based perception without modification of its decision logic.
requirements.rationale: The decision logic is verified once with idealized input and reused unchanged with ML input.

requirements.name: ODD_01_IntersectionGeometry
requirements.text: The system shall represent one four-arm signalized intersection with right-hand traffic, one inbound and one outbound lane per arm, a stop line on each inbound lane and one pedestrian crossing per arm.
requirements.rationale: Fixes the road geometry of the ODD, so that every conflict between movements is known in advance and can be checked exhaustively.

requirements.name: ODD_02_RoadUserPopulation
requirements.text: The system shall simulate at most 4 vehicle agents, of which at most 1 is a smart vehicle, and at most 6 pedestrian agents at the same time.
requirements.rationale: Enough road users for interactions between the smart vehicle, conventional vehicles and pedestrians, while keeping the state space and the test effort bounded.

requirements.name: ODD_03_StraightThroughOnly
requirements.text: The system shall move vehicle agents straight through the intersection only, without turning, overtaking or reversing.
requirements.rationale: Limits the conflicts to the two crossing movement groups; turning movements are a planned extension.

requirements.name: ODD_04_VehicleSpeedRange
requirements.text: The system shall keep the speed of every vehicle agent between 0 m/s and 8.5 m/s.
requirements.rationale: 8.5 m/s (about 30 km/h) is a typical urban approach speed and bounds the stopping distance used in AGT-03.

requirements.name: ODD_05_PedestrianSpeedRange
requirements.text: The system shall move every pedestrian agent at a walking speed between 0.8 m/s and 1.8 m/s.
requirements.rationale: Covers slow (vulnerable) to fast pedestrians; the lower bound sets the minimum clearance time of SIG-05.

requirements.name: ODD_06_RejectOutOfOddScenario
requirements.text: If a scenario specifies a road-user type, movement, speed or number of agents outside the limits of ODD-01 to ODD-05, then the system shall reject the scenario and report every violated limit.
requirements.rationale: Guarantees that every run stays inside the domain for which the model is designed and verified.
requirements.source: Road authority; operator; course team; conflict C3
